work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letters CCXLVII grant the priest Pasquale Parente and future priors of the Carmelite confraternity of Scanno (diocese of Sulmona) rochet and violet mantellone; LF52984 → LF52991 across the right half MDCCCXXXIX., of the page-361 running title LF52987 (same baseline as LF52913) and page number 361 LF52990; complete 13 September 1839 closing. Own provenance LF53060 excluded. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF52949–52949; the source closing at LF53022–53025 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die decima tertia sep- tembris millesimo octingentesimo — trigesimo nono, pontificatus Nostri anno nono. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
